records.title: Mosaic: Composite Projection Pruning for Resource-efficient LLMs
records.reason: Mosaic targets foundation LLM deployment directly: projection-specific pruning balances quality and runtime footprint. Full text confirms decoder projections, pruning control, and hardware inference/memory evaluation.

records.title: Saliency-driven Dynamic Token Pruning for Large Language Models
records.reason: Dynamic token pruning reduces LLM attention work during inference, with explicit FLOPs and latency measurements.

records.title: Scaling Test-Time Inference with Policy-Optimized, Dynamic Retrieval-Augmented Generation via KV Caching and Decoding
records.reason: Although much of the work concerns RAG answer quality, CRITIC explicitly targets KV-cache memory bottlenecks and the abstract names decoding efficiency; retain this plausible inference-systems connection.

records.title: Resona: Improving Context Copying in Linear Recurrence Models with Retrieval
records.reason: The work builds on a compute-efficient recurrent architecture, but reports quality gains from retrieval rather than inference cost, memory, latency, or serving improvements; the systems-efficiency connection is indirect.

records.title: 2-D Transformer: Extending Large Language Models to Long-Context With Few Memory
records.reason: IEEE DOI publisher route returned “URL ... is not accessible via this tool”; PubMed confirms the DOI and title but is an index, not primary abstract evidence. No primary abstract retrieved.

records.title: FP4DiT: Towards Effective Floating Point Quantization for Diffusion Transformers
records.reason: This targets image-generation diffusion models, not LLM inference or serving.

records.title: DiscQuant: A Quantization Method for Neural Networks Inspired by Discrepancy Theory
records.reason: The primary abstract directly tests LLM weight quantization, a model-size and inference-cost reduction path.

records.title: VTrans: Accelerating Transformer Compression with Variational Information Bottleneck based Pruning
records.reason: This compresses pretrained transformers/LLMs to resource constraints and reduces model footprint for deployment.

records.title: Ultra-Long Sequence Distributed Transformer
records.reason: The abstract describes distributed sequence training only; inference and serving are not studied.

records.title: A Unified Framework for Speculative Decoding with Multiple Drafters as a Bandit
records.reason: The paper targets speculative decoding acceleration and adaptive drafter selection at generation time.

records.title: CD-LLM: A Heterogeneous Multi-FPGA System for Batched Decoding of 70B+ LLMs Using a Compute-Dedicated Architecture
records.reason: The author-hosted primary paper reports batch-256 Llama-3.1-70B throughput and throughput/TCO comparisons. ACM DOI page returned 403; retrieved first-party lab manuscript.

records.title: ZipVL: Accelerating Vision-Language Models Through Dynamic Token Sparsity
records.reason: This is multimodal LLM inference optimization: sparse attention reduces prefill compute and dropping visual tokens reduces decode cache. Primary ICCV proceedings PDF retrieved.

records.title: Breadcrumbs Reasoning: Memory-Efficient Reasoning with Compression Beacons
records.reason: Directly targets KV-cache growth and memory/computation costs during long-context reasoning.

records.title: Compressed Convolutional Attention: Efficient Attention in a Compressed Latent Space
records.reason: Directly reports cache, compute, and prefill effects for dense and MoE LLMs.

records.title: Thinking-Free Policy Initialization Makes Distilled Reasoning Models More Effective and Efficient Reasoners
records.reason: Training initialization is central, but the method has an explicit inference token reduction that can lower decoding work.

records.title: Learning to Parallel: Accelerating Diffusion Large Language Models via Adaptive Parallel Decoding
records.reason: Optimizes parallel token generation and stopping during LLM inference, with explicit speed measurements.

records.title: HiPO: Hybrid Policy Optimization for Dynamic Reasoning in LLMs
records.reason: Reducing unnecessary reasoning tokens is a direct inference-workload and serving-cost mechanism.

records.title: CompLLM: Compression for Long Context Q&A
records.reason: Full text confirms independent segment compression, reuse, and TTFT/cache effects in long-context LLMs.

records.title: APT-LLM: Exploiting Arbitrary-Precision Tensor Core Computing for LLM Acceleration
records.reason: This is an LLM GPU kernel/runtime contribution with measured inference speedups across hardware.

records.title: Autoregressive Image Generation with Linear Complexity: A Spatial-Aware Decay Perspective
records.reason: The target is image generation, not LLM inference or serving.
